verdicts.support: The primary objective of this pilot randomized controlled trial (RCT) was to determine the preliminary effectiveness of a live online exercise program from qualified instructors on older adults’ levels of PA compared to a waitlist control group.
verdicts.attack: Checked for dropped 'preliminary' or 'pilot' hedge; 'preliminary effectiveness' is retained.

verdicts.support: However, older adults have described numerous barriers to participating in PA and exercise, including lack of access to places to exercise
verdicts.attack: Looked for an added barrier type or population; none added.

verdicts.reason: Design and comparison match the quotes.
verdicts.support: This pilot convergent parallel mixed-methods RCT was guided by the CONSORT 2010 statement; The RCT compared community-dwelling older adults participating in a live online exercise program (ACTIVE) delivered on Zoom to a waitlist control group (CON).
verdicts.attack: Checked every design label (pilot, convergent parallel, mixed-methods, randomized); all are quoted.

verdicts.reason: Population, location, channels and dates match the quotes.
verdicts.support: Older community-dwelling women and men between the ages of 65 and 80 were recruited from Hamilton, Ontario, and the surrounding area.; Participants were recruited through newsletters, social media, and the local newspaper (Coffee News) between November 10th, 2020, and November 30th, 2021
verdicts.attack: 'in Hamilton' omits 'and the surrounding area', but an omission does not assert anything beyond the quote, and 'Canada' is quoted.

verdicts.reason: Instruments and interview mode are quoted.
verdicts.support: armband BodyMedia Sensewear Pro II accelerometer; Questionnaires were administered online using LimeSurvey; Semi-structured, open-ended 1:1 interviews were conducted and audio recorded via Zoom
verdicts.attack: Checked for an added instrument property such as 'validated'; none added.

verdicts.support: were analyzed using a two-way repeated measures ANOVA; Semi-structured interviews were thematically analyzed using the computer software Dedoose Version 9.0.17
verdicts.attack: Checked whether ANOVA was applied to a different outcome; the sentence names no outcome, so no mismatch.

verdicts.reason: CONSORT guidance is quoted and no theory quote exists.
verdicts.support: This pilot convergent parallel mixed-methods RCT was guided by the CONSORT 2010 statement: extension for pilot and feasibility trials
verdicts.attack: CONSORT is a reporting guideline, but the sentence does not call it a theory and correctly says no theory is named.

verdicts.support: We observed an interaction (p = 0.012) for the Geriatric Depression Scale where the ACTIVE group decreased from pre-to-post intervention
verdicts.attack: Checked p value, outcome and group; all identical.

verdicts.support: We observed an interaction (p = 0.014) for life-space mobility where the ACTIVE group increased from pre-to-post intervention
verdicts.attack: Time point 'pre-to-post' dropped, but that does not widen the claim.

verdicts.support: There were no differences between groups for daily steps and daily active energy expenditure; There were no significant between or within-group differences for symptoms of anxiety and loneliness
verdicts.attack: Checked that 'between groups' vs 'between or within-group' is kept per outcome; it is.

verdicts.support: Attendance rates were 97% in the ACTIVE group; participants reported being either satisfied or very satisfied with the intervention 98% of the time
verdicts.attack: Checked 97% and 98% belong to attendance and satisfaction respectively; they do.

verdicts.support: The program did not affect participants’ habitual PA levels but reduced depressive symptoms, improved life-space mobility, and had excellent adherence and acceptability.
verdicts.attack: Causal wording 'reduced' is the authors' own, attributed to them.

verdicts.support: Online exercise programs are viable service-delivery options, particularly when in-person programming is unavailable; Future work should focus on synchronous online resources to engage older adults in exercise programs.
verdicts.attack: Checked for widened population; 'older adults' is in the quote.

verdicts.support: primarily, we acknowledge the small sample size; The study was a pilot and, therefore, underpowered to determine if there was an interaction for our primary outcome.
verdicts.attack: Checked the outcome scope; 'primary outcome' retained.

verdicts.support: Another limitation of the study includes a lack of blinding for our assessors and participants to group allocation.; Our study only included English-speaking individuals with internet access at home with a tablet, computer, or phone.
verdicts.attack: Device detail dropped, which narrows rather than widens.
